candidates.source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine — snapshots of cnb.cz payment statistics pages
candidates.why_relevant: ČNB restructured its payment-statistics collection (methodology changes effective 1 Jan 2023 and 1 Jan 2024) and retires/relocates dataset pages; Wayback preserves the superseded series, old ARAD table layouts and withdrawn methodological notes needed for long time-series continuity on cards, ATMs, POS and payment volumes.
candidates.legal_status: public archive; Internet Archive terms of use apply, robots-driven exclusions possible
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Wayback CDX API (http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=cnb.cz/cs/statistika/*&output=json) to enumerate snapshots, then fetch selected timestamped captures; rate-limit politely
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from ČNB methodology pages
queries_used: web archive Czech National Bank payment statistics old dataset
Webarchiv NK ČR archiv webových stránek ČNB statistiky platebního styku

candidates.source_name: Webarchiv — Národní knihovna ČR (Czech national web archive)
candidates.why_relevant: National legal-deposit web archive of the .cz domain: full-domain crawls, selective and thematic collections. Preserves defunct Czech bank, fintech, payment-association and trade-press sites (and their statistics pages) that Wayback covers thinly; the only realistic archive for smaller CZ actors.
candidates.access_status: partly restricted — much of the archive is accessible only from National Library terminals unless the publisher granted a licence; catalogue/metadata browsable online
candidates.legal_status: legal deposit / licensed; copyright restrictions on remote access
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Browse/search the public interface for licensed titles; use it primarily as a discovery index of retired CZ sites, then attempt the same URLs in Wayback for full text
queries_used: Webarchiv NK ČR archiv webových stránek ČNB statistiky platebního styku

candidates.source_name: Veřejný rejstřík a Sbírka listin (or.justice.cz) — Czech commercial register & document collection
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory filings (účetní závěrka, výroční zpráva) for payment institutions, e-money issuers, acquirers, ATM operators and cash-in-transit firms that publish nothing else. Quantifies private actors' revenue, terminal/ATM fleet commentary and ownership — the only public numeric window on much of the CZ payments supply side.
candidates.access_status: open, free, no registration; PDF scans of filings
candidates.legal_status: public register under Act 304/2013 Sb.; reuse permitted, personal data caution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Look up by IČO via the rejstrik form, then pull Sbírka listin PDFs per subject; combine with ARES for IČO resolution; PDFs often scanned → OCR
queries_used: obchodní rejstřík justice.cz sbírka listin účetní závěrka platební instituce

candidates.source_name: dataor.justice.cz — open data of the Czech public registers
candidates.why_relevant: Bulk CSV/XML exports of public-register entries (from ~1900 to present), filterable by registry court, legal form and period. Enables systematic construction of a CZ payments actor map (all firms with payment-related NACE/objects of business) rather than one-off lookups.
candidates.legal_status: open data, terms of use published on the portal
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled bulk download of CSV/XML dumps; local DB join with ARES and ČNB registry lists
queries_used: data.justice.cz otevřená data sbírka listin veřejný rejstřík dumps

candidates.source_name: ARES — Administrativní registr ekonomických subjektů (ares.gov.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregation layer merging commercial register, trade register, ČSÚ register of economic subjects and tax data. Canonical IČO resolver and NACE classifier for payment/ATM/POS companies; the entry point for building and de-duplicating a CZ actor map.
candidates.access_status: open, free, no registration; REST and legacy XML APIs
candidates.legal_status: open data (mandatorily published dataset)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: REST API queries by name/IČO/NACE; open-data dumps documented at ares.gov.cz/stranky/otevrena-data
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query (cs) + snowball to MF open-data catalogue

negative_findings.description: No evidence found that Radio Prague International or Emerging Europe maintain a dedicated, recurring Czech payments/cards/ATM statistics beat.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only general station/outlet descriptions and occasional one-off items; no payments section or standing series identified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: English re-publication of CZ payment statistics is opportunistic, not systematic — the English layer cannot be relied on as a monitoring channel and must be backstopped by Czech-language sources.

negative_findings.description: No search result surfaced a Webarchiv NK ČR thematic collection ('tematická sklizeň') specifically covering banking, finance or payments, nor a direct Webarchiv permalink to archived cnb.cz statistics pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Czech-language query returned only Webarchiv's general description pages (webarchiv.cz, nkp.cz) and standardy.ndk.cz documentation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If no finance-themed harvest exists, Webarchiv coverage of retired CZ payment-sector sites may be limited to broad domain crawls with unpredictable depth; a targeted nomination of key sites to Webarchiv may be worth doing.

negative_findings.description: Much of Webarchiv NK ČR is not remotely accessible: archived content is available online only where the publisher granted a licence, otherwise only from National Library terminals.
negative_findings.result_summary: Described by NK ČR/NDK documentation; not tested by fetch in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The national archive cannot be used as an automated collection endpoint; it is a discovery/last-resort layer requiring on-site or licensed access.

negative_findings.description: No public bulk/API endpoint was found for the Sbírka listin document PDFs themselves; dataor.justice.cz exposes register entries (CSV/XML) but the filings appear to remain per-subject PDF downloads via the or.justice.cz UI.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results describe dataor.justice.cz exports of register data and or.justice.cz UI access to the document collection, but no documented filings API.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Systematic financial-statement harvesting for CZ payment firms will need per-IČO scraping plus OCR, or a commercial layer such as Merk — a real cost and a robots/rate-limit compliance question. Unverified; worth a direct check of or.justice.cz robots.txt and terms.

negative_findings.description: Bisnode (now part of Dun & Bradstreet) was returned only as a generic encyclopaedic entry; no current Czech-market product page or access terms for CZ financial-statement data were confirmed in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A major commercial aggregation layer for CZ corporate financials may be under-mapped; requires a follow-up pass on dnb.com CZ offerings.

coverage_gaps.description: No mechanism identified yet that proactively captures ČNB/ČSÚ payment-statistics pages at the moment of publication, so restructuring risk is only partly mitigated by opportunistic Wayback crawls.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a scheduled job: poll ČNB RSS, and on any statistics/methodology item POST the URL to the Wayback 'save page now' endpoint plus store a local copy of the dataset file.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell established the registry infrastructure (ARES, dataor, or.justice.cz) but did not yet enumerate the specific CZ payment-sector legal entities (acquirers, ATM independent deployers, cash-in-transit, POS vendors, payment institutions) whose filings should be tracked.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross ČNB's registry of payment institutions and e-money issuers against ARES NACE codes (64.19, 66.19, 82.99) to produce a tracked IČO list, then schedule annual Sbírka listin pulls each October (filings due 30 September).

coverage_gaps.description: The English-language re-publication layer is dominated by one consumer outlet (Expats.cz); ČTK's English wire — the likely main channel — is subscription-gated and was not accessed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Evaluate a ČTK English service subscription or at least map which CZ payment stories reach it; add Brno Daily / Prague Morning as additional English candidates in a follow-up pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Newsletter-format aggregators (Czech fintech/banking newsletters, LinkedIn-native digests) were not covered; only RSS-based aggregation was mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on 'newsletter fintech Česko', 'bankovní newsletter odběr' and Substack/Ecomail-hosted CZ finance digests.

coverage_gaps.description: robots.txt, rate limits and terms of use were not inspected for or.justice.cz, dataor.justice.cz, ares.gov.cz or web.archive.org in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a compliance check step before any automated collection against these hosts; record allowed crawl rates per host.

brief: The CZ archival/aggregation/translation layer is unusually strong on the corporate-filings side and unusually weak on the preservation side. ARES (ares.gov.cz), the public registers (or.justice.cz) and their bulk open-data exports (dataor.justice.cz, data.gov.cz) together give a free, authoritative route to sizing private payment, ATM and POS actors that publish nothing themselves, with commercial layers (Merk/Imper, Hlídač státu) removing the OCR burden at a licensing cost. Preservation, by contrast, rests mainly on the Internet Archive plus ČNB's own 'archiv' sections: the national Webarchiv exists and crawls the .cz domain, but most of it is not remotely accessible and no finance-themed harvest was found, so retired payment-statistics series should be actively pushed to Wayback rather than assumed archived. The English translation layer (Expats.cz, ČTK English, Radio Prague International, regional trade press) is real but opportunistic — good for surfacing and cross-checking headline figures, never a substitute for the Czech-language primary and registry sources.
